presentation.extension_execution_note: The 8,192-environment state rollouts were measured on 6 November 2026 using the original frozen runtime sources, physical inputs and per-task L40 UUIDs. Baseline and Franka cohorts ran concurrently on separate L40s on the same 16-vCPU host; each cohort ran cases serially with cpu_threads=8. Disk and JIT caches were reused. Separate untimed batch-boundary audits ran after all 18 timed cases and both timing drivers had finished.
